about.descriptor: Builder at the intersection of AI, wireless, and mobility.
about.bio_1: I build systems that work in the real world — not just in demos.
about.bio_2: My projects span MIMO channel estimation with neural networks, vehicle-to-vehicle communication over visible light, and IoT security frameworks. I care about the gap between research and production.
about.bio_3: Currently exploring how machine learning changes the way we design wireless systems. Looking for teams where that question matters.
